title: ValidationRule
description: A single compliance rule from a tender rule pack. Consumed by core_ai/rules engine. Stored in database_schema.

description.example: EMD amount must be >= 2% of quoted value via BG/DD

element.description: Which uploaded document(s) this rule inspects

target.description: Entity/pair/table key to evaluate, e.g. EMD_PERCENTAGE, kv.GSTIN, word('valid until')

expected_value.description: Static comparison value; for llm_judge this is the instruction text

expression.description: Optional compound condition (AND/OR) referencing other targets
